testsuite.name: com.nexient.jazzy.core.sources.DefaultSourceSearcherTest

testcase.name: latency is measured per provider
the same hash from two sites becomes one row with both sites
resolveMagnet scrapes through the owning provider, trying each site
testProvider reports failures, missing logins and unknown ids
settings are re-read on every search
resolveMagnet gives up after 5 s
resolveMagnet fails with a reason when nothing is found
a hanging provider times out after 15 s of virtual time without blocking others
settings override enablement, base url and auth
emits initially, after each provider, and completes last
auth prefers cookies and ignores blanks
rows without a hash keep a provider-scoped key and a resolve hint
unsupported media type only gives one complete emission
a provider is done when at least one of its queries succeeded
no enabled provider gives one complete emission
testProvider runs the known search even for a disabled site
provider list describes every built-in site
providers without a movie category search their default category
when every query fails the first failure is reported
movie queries use the movie category, original title and imdb id where supported
resolveMagnet returns a listed magnet or builds one from the hash
episode search runs three queries in the tv category and keeps only matching rows
failure mapping never leaks urls
